relationships.subject: VEGF rs3025039 polymorphism
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings provide statistical evidence supporting the association between the rs3025039 polymorphism and diabetic neuropathy susceptibility, with the C allele conferring a higher risk than the T allele.

relationships.subject: VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) plays a crucial role in angiogenesis and microvascular function.

key_findings: Meta-analysis of seven studies found VEGF rs3025039 associated with diabetic neuropathy susceptibility, with the C allele conferring higher risk than T.
